summary: KHALABA v2 full-stack regression. Backend: 38/39 pytest pass (1 outdated assertion in old test about facility scope). All new v2 modules (zones, complications, postnatal, newborns, death-audits, direct-channel, sectorisation, khalaba_id, HepB/anemia alerts, neonatal_deaths KPI) verified end-to-end. Frontend: Landing with Tchad mortality stats OK, palette terracotta/sand/chocolate applied, sage-femme login + patientes list shows ID Khalaba KH-TD-* column, sectorisation hides Moundou patients, patient detail has 6 tabs and Canal direct modal opens with ch-submit and proper fields.

minor.issue: UserPublic model does not expose `zone_id`. Frontend cannot know midwife's zone from the user object. Sectorisation still works server-side, but client-side awareness is impossible.
Asserts `patient.facility_id == midwife.facility_id`, but new behavior is zone-scoped (across facilities of the same zone). Outdated test, not a real bug. Should be updated.
No single-resource pregnancy fetch endpoint; only list. Minor – workaround via filter.

ui_bugs.issue: Patient row link uses an 'Ouvrir' text-link; no data-testid 'patient-row-{id}' or 'patient-khalaba-id' as documented in test plan

action_items: Add `zone_id` to UserPublic model in /app/backend/server.py so frontend knows the midwife's zone (returned by /api/auth/login and /api/auth/me).
Update old test test_midwife_lists_patients_of_facility to assert zone_id scope (or remove – superseded by v2 sectorisation test).
(Optional) Add `data-testid="patient-row-{id}"` and `data-testid="patient-khalaba-id"` on PatientList rows to match documented test plan.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1646 lines – consider splitting into routers (auth, patients, pregnancy/cpn, postnatal, zones, mpdsr, admin) for maintainability.
UserPublic strips zone_id (line 88-97). Affects frontend visibility of sage-femme zone.
No GET /api/pregnancies/{id}, but PostnatalModal/NewbornModal may need it – consider adding for completeness.
Many new modules (Postnatal, Newborn, DeathAudit, DirectChannel) defined but only one GET path each – ensure RBAC tests for all GET variants exist.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested critical flows (landing, login, patient list, sectorisation, detail tabs, direct channel modal)

Login flow needs intermediate click on 'Je suis professionnel ou administrateur' before email/password fields appear.
rca of the issue: UserPublic model in server.py omits zone_id field. Pydantic `extra='ignore'` strips zone_id from the DB doc when serializing. Fix: add `zone_id: Optional[str] = None` to UserPublic.
mocked_apis_observed: /api/dashboard/coverage-trend returns synthetic 6-month series as intentionally documented
